scenario: After a long-term imprisonment and while awaiting a parole decision, a convicted murderer wants to organise a foundation for young victims of crime. I am the president of the agency who decides about the foundation. The founder would donate 125,000 dollars to the foundation. However, he asks that the foundation would be named after himself, helping clear his name. The family of his victim opposes such a foundation and considers it immoral. If I approve and accept the money for the foundation, crime victims will benefit from the 125,000 dollars. If I do nothing, the money will be lost.
choice: I decide to accept the donation and name the foundation after the murderer
entities: I,the convicted murderer / proposed founder,the family members of the murder victim,young crime victims who would receive support from the foundation if it is approved
outcomes: Young victims of crime receive support from the 125,000 dollars
The convicted murderer gains public recognition through the foundation's name
The victim's family feels hurt and outraged
The victim's family sees the foundation as honoring the murderer
